name: Invocation of Doom
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, shaman 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as doom except creatures normally immune to fear effects, whether by immunity to fear or to mind-affecting, are still affected by this spell. This does not cause the creature to be susceptible to further fear effect, nor can it be used to increase a fear condition above shaken.
